hazards.description: The walkway is extremely narrow and lacks any buffer from the adjacent travel lane, placing pedestrians in close proximity to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the front of the blue and tan buildings

hazards.name: Frequent driveway conflict points
hazards.description: Large, frequent curb cuts for parking lot access create numerous points where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk on both the left and right sides

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the travel lane or parking area with no physical separation like trees or a furniture zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk on both sides

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk slabs are cracked and uneven, creating potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground

hazards.name: Undefined Vehicle Conflict Zone
hazards.description: The wide, open interface between the sidewalk and the parking lot allows vehicles to cross the pedestrian path at multiple points without clear channelization.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground across the sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway without traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large blue dumpster is placed directly on the narrow paved walkway, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the building frontage

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Conflict Zone
hazards.description: The wide roll-up doors and lack of defined driveway markings create a large area where heavy vehicles may cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the building frontage

hazards.name: Lack of dedicated walkway
hazards.description: There is no separated sidewalk; pedestrians must walk through an active parking area or on the roadway shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Uncontrolled pedestrian crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals are provided despite the presence of commercial destinations on both sides of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Excessive Driveway Width
hazards.description: The extremely wide driveway creates a long, unprotected conflict zone where pedestrians are exposed to turning vehicles without clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, where the sidewalk meets the large asphalt parking lot entrance.

hazards.name: Industrial Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple wide curb cuts for industrial access create frequent conflict points between pedestrians and heavy vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entrances to the blue and tan industrial facilities

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible for crossing the two-lane roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Narrow and obstructed sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is extremely narrow and obstructed by utility poles, forcing pedestrians closer to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is cracked with grass growing through gaps, creating a trip hazard and uneven walking surface.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, along the bottom edge of the yard

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large bush obscures sightlines between the sidewalk and the adjacent driveway/alleyway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, adjacent to the brick house

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, raised, and ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated path.

interventions.title: Curb and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a raised curb and a landscaped buffer or furniture zone on the left side to physically separate pedestrians from the parking lot and traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage to facilitate safer midblock crossings.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to provide a clear, ADA-compliant walking path that accommodates utility poles without obstructing movement.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the road.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Curbing
interventions.description: Install continuous curbing with clearly defined, narrowed driveway entrances to reduce the number of conflict points between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide designated and safer crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement measures such as lane narrowing or speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this industrial corridor.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance to the minimum necessary for vehicle access, slowing turning speeds and shortening the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening and obstruction removal
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, ADA-compliant walking path.

interventions.title: Internal Pedestrian Walkways
interventions.description: Install clearly marked and physically protected walkways through the parking lot to connect the street sidewalk directly to store entrances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated lighting along the sidewalk and internal walkways to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Paved Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct ADA-compliant, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Vertical Curbs and Gutters
interventions.description: Add vertical curbing to physically separate the pedestrian realm from the roadway and manage drainage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the roadway and the sidewalk to provide physical separation and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: High-visibility midblock crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the center turn lane to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Street trees and furniture zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of curb cuts to minimize conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Replace cracked and uneven concrete slabs to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Landscape Buffer or Bollards
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or a row of bollards between the sidewalk and the parking lot to physically separate pedestrians from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffering
interventions.description: Widen the existing walkway to at least 6 feet and add a landscaped or hardscaped buffer to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Consolidated Driveways
interventions.description: Clearly define and narrow the vehicle access points to the building to reduce the conflict area with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway to the minimum necessary for vehicle access to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning speeds.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and elevation across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority to entering and exiting drivers.

interventions.title: Signage Consolidation
interventions.description: Move or consolidate signs to a single pole located outside the clear walking path to improve accessibility and reduce clutter.

interventions.title: Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Add marked bike lanes to narrow the travel lanes, which naturally slows traffic and provides additional buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Completion
interventions.description: Construct wide, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street, ensuring they are free of obstructions like utility poles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian-actuated signals at regular intervals to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove the large bush to restore sightlines at the driveway entrance.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.
